headline: Is Truist Financial (TFC) A Bargain As New Dividends Put Valuation In Focus?
summary: Truist Financial (TFC) is back in focus after the board declared regular cash dividends on both its common and multiple preferred stock series, with ex-dividend dates scheduled for mid August and payments set for early September.
